/usr/local/texlive/2025/texmf-dist/tex/g.findings: Full tick states consume segment length. A short remainder switches to last, whose width is amplitude; both painted states draw from local origin to polar(angle, amplitude), and final moves to the child endpoint.

State width installs a strict remaining-distance switch to final. Exact-width states execute, while last is suppressed if its positive remainder is shorter than amplitude. State geometry uses the current input tangent transform.
TikZ wraps the selected decoration in pre=lineto, main child, and post=lineto states, applies mirror before local-y raise, and exposes actual child-state progress to the post child.
